title: Butterfly
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9de2'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff5bc8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c2188b'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad2' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e6ff'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0277bd'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='spotGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff9c4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd54f'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- upper left wing -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='32' rx='22' ry='18' transform='rotate(-20 28 32)' fill='url(#wingGrad)'/>
  <!-- upper right wing -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='32' rx='22' ry='18' transform='rotate(20 72 32)' fill='url(#wingGrad)'/>

  <!-- lower left wing -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='62' rx='16' ry='14' transform='rotate(15 33 62)' fill='url(#wingGrad2)'/>
  <!-- lower right wing -->
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='62' rx='16' ry='14' transform='rotate(-15 67 62)' fill='url(#wingGrad2)'/>

  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='url(#spotGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='url(#spotGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ffe082'/>

  <!-- wing vein accents -->
  <path d='M28 20 Q30 32 34 45' stroke='#ffb3e6' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M72 20 Q70 32 66 45' stroke='#ffb3e6' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M33 52 Q35 60 38 70' stroke='#81d4fa' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M67 52 Q65 60 62 70' stroke='#81d4fa' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='5' ry='22' fill='#8d6e63'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='3.5' ry='19' fill='#a1887f'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='6' fill='#8d6e63'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='4.5' fill='#a1887f'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#1b1b2f'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#1b1b2f'/>
  <circle cx='48.2' cy='25.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53.2' cy='25.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M48 29.5 Q50 31.5 52 29.5' stroke='#5d4037' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M47 22 Q42 10 38 6' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 22 Q58 10 62 6' stroke='#a1887f' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='6' r='2.5' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='6' r='2.5' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='6' r='1.2' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='6' r='1.2' fill='#fff9c4'/>

  <!-- body segments -->
  <path d='M45.5 40 Q50 42 54.5 40' stroke='#6d4c41' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 50 54 48' stroke='#6d4c41' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M46.5 56 Q50 58 53.5 56' stroke='#6d4c41' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
